ADV0001|Decline financial transfers|S1|ADV0027,ADV0044|The central outgoing-money boundary applies to the financial-request versions and prospectively elsewhere; account-opening and incoming-money tasks require a different transaction role.

ADV0002|Disengage if concerns increase|S2|ADV0008,ADV0036|Disengagement is a distinct response to assessed concerns; reporting and preserving messages do not themselves end contact. Keep the suspicion condition.

ADV0003|Seek an outside perspective|S1|ADV0125,ADV0077|A trusted person's perspective supports the immediate relationship decision; emotional-support wording is an alternative delivery of this action, while general education is a separate lower-priority task.

ADV0004|Check claimed identity details|S2|ADV0005,ADV0212|A name or occupation search examines claims that a photo search cannot. Retain both methods, with available-information and nonconclusive-result limits.

ADV0005|Check photograph reuse|S2|ADV0004,ADV0240|Image reuse is a different check from searching biographical claims. Its absence cannot authenticate Alex; retain the realistic-image limitation as a companion.

ADV0007|Submit a consumer-protection report|R3|ADV0008,ADV0036|An official report is a distinct escalation route, not covered by a platform report. Reserve the route-specific step because the present task is an ambiguous pre-loss relationship decision.

ADV0008|Report concerning platform conduct|S2|ADV0002,ADV0036|The original platform is a known service that can act on an account. This is a conditional account-level action, unlike identifying the correct official crime-reporting route.

ADV0009|Recognize urgent irreversible-payment tactics|S2|ADV0001,ADV0044|Adds recognition of a particular payment-pressure mechanism; the refusal rule and pause rule do not explain it. Use only as a future warning, never as the stated conversational urgency.

ADV0010|Reduce publicly exposed personal details|S1|ADV0052,ADV0141,ADV0243|The broad public-disclosure boundary permits several implementations without requiring a specific profile format or self-search; private secrets require separate coverage.

ADV0011|Slow the relationship and ask questions|S1|ADV0081,ADV0122|Sets a relationship-wide pace rather than only pausing one pressured decision; inquiry also supplies information for subsequent checks.
ADV0012|Reassess moving off-platform|S1|ADV0058,ADV0050|The move to private messaging is stated. Retain the warning and the practical safer-channel options as recognition and action, not duplicates.

ADV0013|Maintain access to outside relationships|S2|ADV0003,ADV0018|Protects access to the selected trusted-person check if interference develops. Isolation and secrecy are related but different ways that outside support can be obstructed.

ADV0014|Protect intimate images|S2|ADV0140,ADV0020|Intimate media have a distinct disclosure risk not captured by documents or verbal secrets. This is a standing boundary, not an assertion of a sexual request.

ADV0015|Assess repeated avoidance of checks|S3|ADV0153,ADV0212|Helps interpret the proposed contact check without equating one scheduling difficulty with deception. The existing failure to meet is not a demonstrated refusal of a call.

ADV0016|Submit a cybercrime report|R3|ADV0008,ADV0036|A distinct official escalation route remains available after stronger evidence. It is not interchangeable with a platform report and is not needed for every preventive response.

ADV0017|Assess intensity of expressed attachment|S1|ADV0011,ADV0025|Directly addresses Alex's manipulated emotional expression; guilt in response to doubts is a separate later interaction. Do not infer the recipient's feelings.

ADV0018|Resist secrecy and exclusive-trust demands|S2|ADV0013,ADV0003|Secrecy can inhibit consulting others even without overt isolation. Retain as a conditional obstacle to the selected outside-perspective action, not an existing demand.

ADV0019|Assess coercive reactions to boundaries|S3|ADV0057,ADV0081|Anger or breakup threats after a boundary provide different information from evasive identity answers; retain as a conditional follow-up to recommended questioning or refusal.

ADV0020|Protect identity documents|S2|ADV0021,ADV0121|Government identifiers differ from financial details and account credentials; refusing their disclosure is a standing boundary during identity checking.

ADV0021|Protect banking and card information|S2|ADV0121,ADV0278|Financial account details are distinct from login secrets and one-time codes. Retain each credential/data type rather than claim that one sentence exhaustively represents all three.

ADV0022|Refuse acting as a money conduit|R3|ADV0001,ADV0027|Receiving and forwarding someone else's funds is a distinct risk, not covered by refusing a loan. It changes the recipient's transaction role beyond Alex's stated request for help.

ADV0023|Inspect available profile history|S2|ADV0137,ADV0212|Examines the existing profile's age and interaction pattern; cross-account comparisons provide a different check. Neither sparse nor rich activity is conclusive.

ADV0024|Recognize indirect solicitation through distress|R3|ADV0009,ADV0212|This interprets distress as engineered solicitation. Retain in reserve because it can manufacture a money motive in no-request versions; general combined-cue assessment remains available.

ADV0025|Recognize guilt used against reasonable doubts|S3|ADV0017,ADV0057|Addresses a reaction to doubt or refusal rather than merely strong attachment. Retain conditionally to support autonomy during the recommended boundary-setting step.

ADV0026|Assess introduced third-party corroboration|R3|ADV0257,ADV0258|An introduced relative or professional is a distinct corroboration channel requiring an additional person not in the case or proposed checking steps. General independent checking does not fully replace it.

ADV0027|Avoid debt incurred for the contact|S2|ADV0001,ADV0022|Borrowing exposes the recipient to debt while funding the stated outgoing request; this financing consequence differs from acting as a conduit for another person's money.

ADV0029|Seek bank advice through a verified channel|R3|ADV0001,ADV0044|Bank consultation is distinct and not fully covered. It concerns a contemplated banking action; the selected response prioritizes assessing or declining the outgoing request before payment administration.

ADV0032|Avoid blaming a victim|R4|ADV0059,ADV0162|Keep all supporter-to-victim communication principles outside the recipient reference pack, including this one. General supportive tone is a task instruction, not evidence that victimization occurred.

ADV0033|Check distinctive message reuse|S2|ADV0004,ADV0239|Searches message content rather than names or images. Fluency is a separate misleading reassurance cue; retain both without inventing copied messages.

ADV0036|Preserve relevant evidence before disengaging|S3|ADV0002,ADV0008|Preservation is a prerequisite for later reporting after blocking. Unlike keeping report receipts, it can prevent losing information during an action the pack already proposes.

ADV0044|Pause and assess financial requests|S1|ADV0001,ADV0122|Connects reflection to the stated financial decision. The general pause principle also covers nonfinancial emotional pressure, so their scopes are complementary.

ADV0045|Choose a service with visibility controls|R2|ADV0048,ADV0058|Choosing a different service is a separate platform-selection task. Current-channel safety remains selected; it does not fully cover evaluating a new service.

ADV0046|Review initial messaging permissions|R2|ADV0048,ADV0058|Initial contact permissions mainly govern new strangers, while Alex is an established contact. This account-setup function is reserved rather than called redundant.

ADV0047|Limit precise location disclosure|S2|ADV0010,ADV0151|A direct location-setting boundary is actionable during current app use; protecting recurring routines is a related implementation with a temporal dimension, retained in reserve.

ADV0048|Locate current blocking/reporting controls|S3|ADV0002,ADV0008|Enables the selected conditional disengagement and platform-reporting actions. General service-selection or data-policy review does not provide this operational access.

ADV0049|Limit confidence in photo badges|S3|ADV0023,ADV0240|A badge can be encountered during the selected profile inspection and may be mistaken for verification. Keep this limitation alongside photo realism, which is a different cue.
ADV0050|Use protected in-app calling|S3|ADV0153,ADV0058|Adds a way to undertake the proposed call without disclosing a phone number; platform messaging alone does not specify call privacy.

ADV0051|Review service data-sharing policy|R2|ADV0010,ADV0058|Platform data governance is a separate account-administration function, not a direct check of Alex or a prerequisite for the selected relationship actions.

ADV0052|Limit identifying profile names|R1|ADV0010|One implementation of minimizing public personal details. The broad boundary covers the decision, while exact nickname choices remain optional and are not semantic duplicates.

ADV0053|Separate public and dating photographs|R1|ADV0010,ADV0054|An implementation of limiting cross-profile discoverability. The selected public-information and account-separation boundaries cover the main decision, not every technical step.

ADV0054|Separate dating and wider social accounts|S2|ADV0010,ADV0053|Adds a cross-account exposure boundary beyond individual public facts; using different photos is one optional implementation of limiting linkage.

ADV0055|Configure multifactor authentication|R2|ADV0121,ADV0278|Account hardening is valuable but distinct from refusing disclosure during this interaction. Reserve configuration work consistently with passwords, updates and account recovery settings.

ADV0056|Use strong unique passwords|R2|ADV0121|Password construction is background account maintenance. Keeping existing login secrets private during the relationship is selected; it does not fully replace password hygiene.
ADV0057|Decline uncomfortable requests|S1|ADV0019,ADV0143|Establishes an immediate right to refuse, while interpreting reactions and pausing contact are complementary follow-up actions.

ADV0058|Use the dating platform's messaging controls|S1|ADV0012,ADV0050|Offers a channel decision tied to the stated move off-platform; choosing a new service or configuring initial permissions addresses a different task.

ADV0059|Validate a victim's attachment|R4|ADV0032,ADV0162|The same role rule now applies to all supporter-oriented principles. Do not selectively adapt victim language here while rejecting another tone principle for needing adaptation.

ADV0067|Allow gradual disengagement|R4|ADV0032,ADV0059|A supporter-facing approach to another person's disengagement is reserved with the other delivery principles; the recipient retains the option to pause or stop contact.

ADV0070|Decline unsafe link/file interactions|S2|ADV0269,ADV0277|Links and files are direct messaging exposures. Remote-control authorization has an additional mechanism and is retained separately; payment links are a narrower subtype.

ADV0071|Avoid unsafe third-party verification services|S3|ADV0004,ADV0005,ADV0153|A verification-service trap can arise while pursuing recommended identity checks. Retain this safety limitation; a particular frightening sales pitch is only a subtype.

ADV0075|Reject coercive verification-service pitches|R1|ADV0071,ADV0122|A specific pressure tactic within the selected unsafe-verification-service boundary; the pause rule supplies the response to urgency without adding this exact story.

ADV0077|Consult general official fraud education|R2|ADV0003,ADV0212|General further learning is distinct from seeking a trusted perspective or assessing current cues. Reserve this broad educational task, without claiming those actions fully cover it.

ADV0078|Refuse opening accounts or companies|R3|ADV0001,ADV0022|Requires a new account or business role rather than responding to the stated request for financial help. Its specialized function is reserved, not treated as an outgoing-payment duplicate.

ADV0079|Limit confidence in platform membership|S3|ADV0049,ADV0023|Membership and a photo badge are different potential reassurances when inspecting an existing dating profile. Retain both limitations rather than assume one caveat covers the other.

ADV0080|Check inconsistencies in personal accounts|S2|ADV0081,ADV0098|Substantive contradictions differ from evasive replies; a misaddressed message is one narrower inconsistency example and need not be separately prompted.

ADV0081|Assess evasive identity answers|S3|ADV0011,ADV0015|Interprets answers to the selected questioning action; avoidance of a meeting or call is a different behavior and remains separately qualified.

ADV0085|Limit disclosure of financial position|S2|ADV0021,ADV0140|Income or wealth information is neither a payment credential nor necessarily an intimate secret; it can shape requests even without account access.

ADV0098|Notice misaddressed messages|R1|ADV0080|A concrete inconsistency example within the selected consistency-check function; no such message is stated. Retain the implementation without treating it as an independent required topic.

ADV0111|Limit reassurance from mirrored interests|S3|ADV0011,ADV0212|The case includes reciprocal discussion of lives and experiences. Similarity is not authenticity evidence; this caveat adds a relational reassurance limit without asserting deliberate mirroring.

ADV0121|Protect bank login credentials|S2|ADV0021,ADV0278|Login credentials enable access and should not be assumed fully represented by a warning about banking/card information. Add explicit credential coverage alongside one-time codes.

ADV0122|Pause emotionally pressured decisions|S1|ADV0044,ADV0143|Covers reflection before both financial and personal-information choices; pausing an ongoing conversation is an additional interaction-level option.

ADV0123|Reject document-selfie verification requests|R1|ADV0020,ADV0071|A specific pretext for the selected document-disclosure boundary; safe verification guidance already disallows supplying sensitive credentials or documents to authenticate oneself.

ADV0125|Seek practical and emotional help|R1|ADV0003|The main action is asking a trusted person for support. Preserve this distinct wording and broader support emphasis as an alternative, not a deleted semantic duplicate.

ADV0134|Monitor escalation of financial demands|S3|ADV0001,ADV0044|A sequence of requests adds temporal information beyond assessing one request. Use prospectively and do not invent prior payments or an existing escalation.

ADV0135|Notice changes in communication style|R1|ADV0080,ADV0081|A narrower consistency-check implementation; attributing changes to multiple operators would add an explanation not in the case. Preserve it as a qualified optional cue.

ADV0137|Cross-check public accounts and connections|S2|ADV0182,ADV0257|Cross-account information adds a checking method beyond one profile. Retain both limitations: mutual connections and coordinated messages are not independent authentication.

ADV0140|Protect private sensitive disclosures|S2|ADV0010,ADV0014|Private verbal secrets are not fully represented by public-profile limits or intimate-media boundaries. Add this distinct information category without inventing blackmail.
ADV0141|Audit one's public search footprint|R1|ADV0010|A way to implement the selected public-information boundary; it is not necessary to prescribe this specific audit in every short response.

ADV0142|Check photos for incidental identifiers|R1|ADV0010,ADV0020,ADV0021|One implementation of the selected personal/document/financial disclosure boundaries when sharing images. It remains available without making image sharing a stated event.

ADV0143|Pause an uncomfortable conversation|S1|ADV0057,ADV0122|Provides an immediate communication action, especially for pressure to stay online; decision reflection alone does not explicitly authorize ending the current conversation.

ADV0146|Assess promises tied to contributions|R3|ADV0017,ADV0044|Requires an explicit link between a future relationship promise and payment, not merely separate emotional and financial cues. That unprovided contingency remains reserved.

ADV0147|Interpret backstories as financial preparation|R3|ADV0080,ADV0212|Infers strategic preparation from a history whose deceptive purpose is unknown. Selected checks examine evidence without requiring that causal story.

ADV0150|Refuse misleading a bank|R3|ADV0001,ADV0044|Requires a bank conversation and an instruction to conceal payment details. This distinct downstream behavior is reserved rather than presented as already covered.

ADV0151|Protect routines and habitual locations|R1|ADV0047,ADV0010|An implementation of location and public-information protection with additional temporal detail; retain it as an alternative, not an identical meaning or a wholly covered safety checklist.

ADV0152|Protect children's identifying details|R3|ADV0010,ADV0140|Requires parenthood or responsibility for children's information, neither stated nor needed for the proposed actions. The specialized population remains conditional reserve.

ADV0153|Consider a live conversation|S2|ADV0050,ADV0241|Provides a contact-check option before the contemplated first meeting; retain privacy-preserving implementation and limits against treating video as proof.

ADV0154|Choose a public first-meeting venue|S2|ADV0156,ADV0158|Venue exposure, trusted-person notification and ability to leave serve distinct functions; retain all three rather than use broad meeting coverage as a substitution claim.

ADV0155|Leave an uncomfortable in-person encounter|S3|ADV0154,ADV0158|Adds a response to pressure during the proposed meeting; public venue and transport are enabling precautions, not substitutes for the right to leave.

ADV0156|Notify a trusted person of meeting plans|S2|ADV0154,ADV0158|Creates outside awareness of a meeting; it does not provide a public venue or independent exit. Retain as complementary meeting coverage.

ADV0157|Carry a charged phone to a meeting|S3|ADV0156,ADV0155|Contact capability enables the selected outside-support and exit responses. Do not reserve it merely as detail while retaining other practical meeting precautions.

ADV0158|Keep independent ability to leave|S2|ADV0154,ADV0156|Independent transport supplies exit control absent from venue choice and notification. Add as a distinct safety function for the contemplated first meeting.

ADV0159|Control belongings during a meeting|R2|ADV0020,ADV0021,ADV0158|Physical possession security is a distinct general in-person precaution. Reserve it outside the narrower first-meeting location, communication and exit functions; do not call it redundant.

ADV0161|Allow processing of deception evidence|R4|ADV0032,ADV0162|A supporter-facing communication principle; apply the same reserve rule as other delivery entries, irrespective of whether its wording can be adapted.

ADV0162|Support another adult's autonomous decision|R4|ADV0032,ADV0059|Move to reserve with all delivery principles. Supportive noncoercive writing remains a common task instruction, not a selectively imported victim-support reference.

ADV0167|Record another person's fulfilled promises|R4|ADV0161,ADV0203|Its function belongs to supporter-assisted discussion and record keeping. Reserve under the common role rule rather than selectively adapting it into recipient instructions.

ADV0182|Limit confidence in mutual connections|S3|ADV0137|A direct caveat to the selected mutual-connection check. Add it even though mutual contacts are conditional; the same availability condition applies to method and limitation.

ADV0186|Retain report receipts|R3|ADV0008,ADV0036|Administrative follow-up after a report, not preservation needed before blocking. Reserve this additional stage without equating it with saving original messages.

ADV0199|Choose a private moment for support|R4|ADV0200,ADV0162|A supporter-controlled conversation setting falls outside the recipient pack. All eleven delivery principles now follow the same role rule.

ADV0200|Use listening and nonaccusatory questions|R4|ADV0032,ADV0059|Move this supporter-facing delivery principle to reserve consistently; it is not proof of victimization and no longer receives a special adaptation exception.
ADV0201|Respect readiness to discuss fraud|R4|ADV0162,ADV0161|Reserve with the entire delivery group; do not claim equivalence to one selected tone principle when no delivery principles are selected.

ADV0202|Discuss examples without accusing the contact|R4|ADV0200,ADV0032|A supporter-to-recipient discussion technique, reserved under the role rule. Recipient cue assessment remains a different function.

ADV0203|Ask a recipient about relationship history|R4|ADV0167,ADV0200|Reserve the supporter interview question with the other delivery principles. The scenario already supplies the origin; recipient verification actions remain separate.

ADV0212|Assess cues without a fraud verdict|S1|ADV0004,ADV0017|Provides the general interpretation limit for all checks and emotional cues. Specific caveats remain selected where this broad principle would not identify a particular false reassurance.

ADV0226|Maintain device/software updates|R2|ADV0070,ADV0269|Background account/device maintenance is distinct from deciding whether to open or authorize something in the current interaction. Reserve consistently with other security configuration tasks.
ADV0227|Use a password manager|R2|ADV0121|A password-management implementation belongs to background configuration. It is not fully replaced by the selected interpersonal credential boundary.

ADV0228|Choose stronger authentication technology|R2|ADV0278|A service-dependent configuration choice; declining to share one-time codes is an interaction-level boundary. Retain the distinction rather than claim duplicate coverage.

ADV0229|Configure private recovery answers|R2|ADV0010,ADV0121|Service-dependent account recovery setup lies outside the selected interpersonal decisions; it remains useful background, not an invalid entry.

ADV0239|Limit confidence in fluent messages|S3|ADV0033,ADV0212|Daily written messages are stated, and fluency may be mistaken for authenticity. This is distinct from checking copied wording or general cue combination.

ADV0240|Limit confidence in realistic images|S3|ADV0005,ADV0049|A necessary companion to photo-based checking: realistic or nonmatching images do not establish authenticity. Badge limitations address a different reassurance.
ADV0241|Limit confidence in video verification|S3|ADV0153|Retain with the selected live-call option so the model cannot treat that method as conclusive identity or safety proof.

ADV0242|Compare voice changes to a baseline|R3|ADV0153,ADV0241|Requires an established voice baseline, unlike offering a first live call. The broader video limitation does not fully substitute for this specialized comparison.

ADV0243|Restrict public impersonation material|R1|ADV0010|An implementation of limiting public personal content, with an impersonation rationale. Preserve its distinct emphasis without requiring a separate public-recording audit.

ADV0244|Prepare details for an official report|R3|ADV0036,ADV0008|Preparing a formal report is a further administrative step. Evidence preservation supports it but does not fully cover report preparation; reserve the downstream task.

ADV0247|Locate the US cybercrime reporting site|R3|ADV0008,ADV0036|A jurisdiction-specific official reporting route, reserved under the same downstream-escalation rule as other official reports, not selectively excluded because it is US-specific.

ADV0248|Avoid misleading reporting-site ads|R3|ADV0247,ADV0070|A safety detail for a reporting-site search that is itself reserved. It is not needed to implement a selected task; general link caution remains distinct.

ADV0256|Harden email-account security|R2|ADV0121,ADV0278|Account-recovery infrastructure is useful background configuration, consistently reserved with passwords and authentication setup rather than claimed covered by disclosure limits.

ADV0257|Limit confidence in coordinated channels|S3|ADV0137,ADV0258|Companion to cross-account checks: agreement across controlled channels is not independent corroboration. Mutual connections and submitted documents require separate caveats.

ADV0258|Check reassurance independently|S3|ADV0004,ADV0081|Provides a response to evidence offered during the recommended inquiry; independent checking is different from merely finding consistent messages.

ADV0259|Limit confidence in official-looking documents|S3|ADV0258,ADV0020|A document offered during identity checking can look official without being authentic. This is separate from protecting the recipient's own documents; never request their exchange.

ADV0260|Check payee-name discrepancies|R3|ADV0001,ADV0044|Requires an actual contemplated transfer and payment details. Reserve transaction execution checks while prioritizing the decision to send money at all.

ADV0261|Enable available payee-checking services|R2|ADV0260,ADV0001|A bank-specific configuration option belongs with background financial controls; availability is conditional and the transfer itself is not a selected action.

ADV0264|Limit reassurance from received gifts|R3|ADV0212,ADV0258|A gift is neither stated nor a proposed verification method. Its distinct reassurance mechanism stays in reserve rather than being called equivalent to every other cue.

ADV0265|Notice one-sided personal disclosure|R3|ADV0011,ADV0140|The scenario describes Alex sharing experiences; extensive asymmetric questioning is not established. Reserve this additional pattern while retaining inquiry and privacy actions.

ADV0268|Reject unsolicited banking approvals|R3|ADV0278,ADV0121|An unsolicited transaction-approval event is distinct from requests to reveal credentials. Reserve that additional banking event, without claiming the selected secret-sharing rules fully cover it.

ADV0269|Decline remote-control/install requests|S2|ADV0070|Authorization to control a device or install software adds a mechanism beyond opening a link/file. Retain both prospective digital boundaries under the same channel-risk rule.

ADV0273|Configure bank transfer limits|R2|ADV0001,ADV0044|Background banking configuration reduces exposure but does not answer whether to fund Alex. Reserve consistently with other account-security setup tasks.
ADV0274|Configure card-channel controls|R2|ADV0021,ADV0273|Service-specific payment configuration is a distinct background function, not required by the unspecified financial request.

ADV0277|Avoid payment links and QR codes|R1|ADV0070,ADV0001|A payment-specific implementation of the selected untrusted-link and money boundaries; retain the subtype without making a payment link an observed fact.
ADV0278|Protect one-time codes|S2|ADV0121,ADV0021|One-time codes are distinct from persistent login credentials and account details. Explicitly retain all three without claiming equivalent meanings.

ADV0279|Protect access to a personal identity account|R3|ADV0020,ADV0121|Delegating use of a named identity service requires an additional service/account context and localization. Its distinct function remains reserved rather than treated as identical to document secrecy.

ADV0281|Warn others about an identified approach|R3|ADV0003,ADV0212|Public or interpersonal warnings about a scam require stronger grounds than privately seeking advice. Reserve this distinct outward action to avoid an unsupported accusation.
